title: Beef Hash with Thai Spices
description: A spicy twist on traditional beef hash, influenced by Thai cuisine, with a focus on bold flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: Canadian Beef
ingredients.notes: Choose a cut with good marbling for tenderness

instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add Canadian beef cubes and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced corned beef, Thai red curry paste, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add warmed spiced hash and stir-fry until combined, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with chopped cilantro.
Serve hot, with additional cilantro for garnish if desired.
